label: UEFN MCP (Epic)
description: Official Epic in-editor MCP nested under Ducky. UI shows three tools: unreal__list_toolsets, unreal__describe_toolset, unreal__call_tool — then call Valkyrie Device/Entity/Verse/Session toolsets (and editor_toolset.*). Do not add a second IDE mcp.json entry.
requirements_note: Enable the island in Ducky, then open it in UEFN. Default bind http://127.0.0.1:8000/mcp. In Settings → MCPs look for "UEFN MCP (Epic)" (id unreal-mcp). Do not enable a second custom HTTP MCP on the same port.
setup_steps: Enable this island in Ducky. That turns on Python and starts Epic MCP.
Open the project in UEFN (restart once if Epic MCP is still off).
In Settings → MCPs confirm "UEFN MCP (Epic)" is Enabled (slug unreal-mcp).
Do not enable another HTTP/SSE MCP on the same host:port — Ducky blocks that and will disable duplicates.
If port 8000 is taken, set Editor Preferences → Model Context Protocol port, then Settings → MCPs unreal-mcp URL to match.
